paper.title_en: Notes on the singularity theorems of general relativity
paper.abstract_en: The notes begin with an exploration of the local geometry of spacetime and proceed with an investigation of its global causal structure. The results obtained are used to present a proof of the Hawking cosmological and the Penrose black hole singularity theorems. The aim is to give a pedagogical, but still technical, proof of the statements. The notes include a large number of drawings to aid the understanding of the material and many examples to explain key concepts. Some of the mathematical tools utilised in the proof of the singularity theorems are also illustrated. These include an extensive description of the topological and analytic properties of curves and their spaces, of the Arzelá-Ascoli theorem and of the properties of semi-continuous functions. The Hopf-Rinow theorem, which describes the conditions for geodesic completeness in the context of Riemannian manifolds, is also partially demonstrated.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以教学方式系统呈现霍金宇宙学奇点定理与彭罗斯黑洞奇点定理的技术性证明，涵盖局部时空几何、整体因果结构以及Arzelà-Ascoli定理、半连续函数、Hopf-Rinow定理等数学工具，属于广义相对论基础方向，适合研究人员点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 广义相对论奇点定理讲义
decision.abstract_zh: 本讲义首先探讨时空的局部几何，继而研究其整体因果结构。所获得的结果被用于给出霍金宇宙学奇点定理与彭罗斯黑洞奇点定理的证明。目标是对这些命题给出一种教学性、但仍具技术性的证明。讲义包含大量图示以帮助理解材料，并有许多例子用于解释关键概念。奇点定理证明中所使用的一些数学工具也得到了说明，包括对曲线及其空间的拓扑与分析性质、Arzelà-Ascoli定理以及半连续函数性质的详尽描述。此外，还部分论证了Hopf-Rinow定理，该定理描述了黎曼流形背景下测地完备性的条件。
